vulnerability.name: USN-7848-1
vulnerability.description: Oleksii Oleksenko, Cedric Fournet, Jana Hofmann, Boris Köpf, Stavros Volos, and Flavien Solt discovered that some AMD processors may allow an attacker to infer data from previous stores. A local attacker could possibly use this issue to expose sensitive information. This update provides the updated microcode mitigations required for the corresponding Linux kernel update.

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in AMD Microcode.
